reason: Key correct; easy item set to difficulty 1; teaching fields added

fields.hint: First name the relationship between big and small, then apply the same relationship to tall.
fields.whyA: 'Large' is a synonym of big; it does not relate to tall at all.
fields.whyC: 'Wide' measures breadth, not height, so it is not the opposite of tall.
fields.whyD: 'High' is close in meaning to tall, not its opposite.
fields.explanationTl: Magkasalungat ang big at small, kaya ang kasalungat ng tall ay short. Same relationship lang, opposites.
fields.hintTl: Alamin muna kung ano ang relationship ng big at small, tapos i-apply mo sa tall.

reason: Two distractors were near-synonyms of 'generous' making B the odd one out; replaced C and D

fields.hint: Think of how you would describe someone who hates to share or spend.
fields.whyA: 'Kind' is close in meaning to generous, not its opposite.
fields.whyC: 'Humble' is about modesty, not about willingness to give.
fields.whyD: A wealthy person can be generous or stingy; wealth is not the opposite of generosity.
fields.explanationTl: Ang generous ay yung mahilig magbigay. Ang kabaligtaran nito ay stingy, yung kuripot o ayaw mag-share.
fields.hintTl: Isipin mo kung paano mo ide-describe yung taong ayaw magbigay o gumastos.

reason: Distractors replaced (Intense/Significant were near-synonyms); explanation sharpened

fields.explanation: 'Profound' means deep or showing great insight, so its opposite is 'superficial', meaning shallow or concerned only with the surface.
fields.hint: Profound comes from 'deep'; look for the word that means only on the surface.
fields.whyA: 'Deep' is a synonym of profound, not an antonym.
fields.whyC: 'Complicated' describes difficulty, not depth; a profound idea can be simple or complicated.
fields.whyD: 'Silent' relates to sound, not to depth of thought or feeling.
fields.explanationTl: Ang profound ay malalim o may malalim na insight. Ang kabaligtaran nito ay superficial, ibig sabihin mababaw o surface-level lang.
fields.hintTl: Ang profound ay related sa 'deep'. Hanapin mo yung word na ang ibig sabihin ay mababaw.

fields.hint: Meager describes a very small amount. What word describes a very large amount?
fields.whyA: 'Scanty' is a synonym of meager, not its opposite.
fields.whyD: 'Simple' is about complexity; a meal can be simple yet plentiful.
fields.explanationTl: Ang meager ay kakaunti o kulang. Ang kabaligtaran nito ay abundant, ibig sabihin sobrang dami o sagana.
fields.hintTl: Ang meager ay maliit na dami. Ano naman ang word para sa napakaraming dami?

reason: Distractors were three synonyms of 'stupid' (giveaway); replaced with plausible confusions

fields.hint: Ingenious is related to 'genius'. What quality does a genius solution show?
fields.whyA: 'Complicated' confuses cleverness with complexity; ingenious solutions are often simple.
fields.whyC: 'Obvious' is nearly the opposite; an ingenious solution is one others did not think of.
fields.whyD: 'Accidental' implies luck, but ingenious stresses skill and inventiveness.
fields.explanationTl: Ang ingenious ay matalino, malikhain at inventive. Kaya ang ingenious na solution ay clever na solution.
fields.hintTl: Ang ingenious ay kahawig ng 'genius'. Anong quality ang meron sa solution na galing sa genius?

reason: Banned 'Both A and B'/'None' option set; rewritten as context item with one answer

fields.text:
The dog's loud bark woke the whole barangay.

In this sentence, 'bark' means:
fields.optionA: The outer covering of a tree trunk
fields.optionB: The sharp cry of a dog
fields.explanation: 'Bark' has several meanings, but the context (the dog's loud bark woke people) shows it means the sharp sound a dog makes.
fields.hint: Look at who or what is making the bark in the sentence.
fields.whyA: Tree covering is a real meaning of 'bark', but a tree trunk cannot wake anyone up.
fields.whyC: 'Bark' (also 'barque') can mean a sailing ship, but that does not fit a dog.
fields.whyD: An argument can be loud, but 'bark' here belongs to the dog, not to neighbors.
fields.explanationTl: Maraming meaning ang 'bark', pero sa context, yung dog ang may loud bark kaya ito yung tahol ng aso.
fields.hintTl: Tingnan mo kung sino o ano ang gumagawa ng bark sa sentence.

fields.hint: An abstract concept exists as an idea, not as something you can touch.
fields.whyC: 'Summarized' confuses the adjective with the noun 'abstract' (a summary of a paper).
fields.whyD: 'Artistic' comes from 'abstract art', but a concept is not described that way here.
fields.explanationTl: Ang abstract ay idea lang, hindi mo nahahawakan. Kaya ang abstract na concept ay theoretical.
fields.hintTl: Ang abstract na concept ay nasa isip lang, hindi physical na bagay.

reason: Clear context item; teaching fields added

fields.hint: What do you do when you ask a database for information?
fields.whyB: Deleting removes records; a query only asks for them.
fields.whyC: Saving stores data; a query retrieves it.
fields.whyD: Ignoring is the opposite of asking the database anything.
fields.explanationTl: Sa computing, ang query ay pagtatanong o pag-request ng information sa database. Kaya 'question' ang meaning.
fields.hintTl: Ano ang ginagawa mo kapag humihingi ka ng info sa database?

reason: Distractors Reasoned/Planned/Thoughtful were near-duplicates; replaced two

fields.hint: An arbitrary choice is not based on any reason or system.
fields.whyA: 'Reasoned' is the opposite; arbitrary decisions lack reasons.
fields.whyC: 'Final' confuses arbitrary with 'arbiter', who makes a final ruling.
fields.whyD: 'Unanimous' is about how many agreed, not how the decision was made.
fields.explanationTl: Ang arbitrary ay ginawa nang walang malinaw na dahilan, basta trip lang o random. Kaya 'random' ang sagot.
fields.hintTl: Ang arbitrary na desisyon ay walang basehan o system.

reason: Distractors Original/Innovative/Creative were near-duplicates; replaced two

fields.hint: A banal movie has a story you feel you have seen many times before.
fields.whyC: 'Offensive' describes something insulting; banal is merely dull and unoriginal.
fields.whyD: 'Lengthy' is about running time; a short movie can still be banal.
fields.explanationTl: Ang banal ay gasgas na, walang originality, boring. Kaya 'trite' ang synonym.
fields.hintTl: Ang banal na movie ay parang napanood mo na nang maraming beses.

reason: Distractors Virtuous/Good/Moral were near-duplicates; replaced two

fields.hint: Nefarious is often used for criminal plots and villains.
fields.whyC: 'Numerous' may be confused by sound with 'nefarious', but it means many.
fields.whyD: Nefarious schemes may be secret, but the word itself means evil, not mysterious.
fields.explanationTl: Ang nefarious ay masama, wicked, o kriminal. Ginagamit ito sa mga kontrabida at masamang plano.
fields.hintTl: Madalas gamitin ang nefarious para sa mga kontrabida at criminal plots.

reason: Option A 'divided' (adjective) changed to noun 'division' to match part of speech

fields.hint: A consensus is reached when the members share the same view.
fields.whyA: 'Division' is the opposite; consensus means people are not divided.
fields.whyB: 'Controversy' means dispute, the opposite of consensus.
fields.whyC: 'Gathering' confuses consensus with a meeting; a meeting does not guarantee agreement.
fields.explanationTl: Ang consensus ay general agreement, ibig sabihin halos lahat ay magkakapareho ang opinion. Kaya 'agreement' ang sagot.
fields.hintTl: May consensus kapag pareho ang pananaw ng mga miyembro.

reason: Removed joke politician name from stem; 'change' replaced by plausible trap 'amend'

fields.text:
The city council voted to rescind the curfew ordinance.

In this sentence, 'rescind' most nearly means:
fields.explanation: 'Rescind' means to revoke or repeal, that is, to cancel a law or order officially.
fields.hint: Rescinding a law makes it no longer in effect.
fields.whyA: 'Revive' means to bring back, the opposite of rescind.
fields.whyB: 'Amend' means to modify a law while keeping it; rescinding cancels it entirely.
fields.whyD: 'Rescue' only looks similar to 'rescind'; it means to save.
fields.explanationTl: Ang rescind ay i-revoke o i-repeal, ibig sabihin kanselahin officially ang batas o order.
fields.hintTl: Kapag ni-rescind ang isang batas, wala na itong bisa.

reason: Distractors Verbose/Talkative/Loquacious were near-duplicates; replaced two; stem given context

fields.text:
She gave a laconic reply to the reporters' questions.

In this sentence, 'laconic' most nearly means:
fields.hint: A laconic reply uses very few words.
fields.whyA: 'Verbose' means wordy, the opposite of laconic.
fields.whyC: 'Lazy' confuses laconic with 'lackadaisical'; laconic is about few words, not effort.
fields.whyD: A short reply may sound cold, but laconic means brief, not sad.
fields.explanationTl: Ang laconic ay maikli magsalita, kaunting words lang. Kaya ang laconic na sagot ay concise.
fields.hintTl: Ang laconic na sagot ay gumagamit ng kaunting salita lang.

fields.explanation: 'Prolific' means producing a large amount (of work, fruit or offspring), so its synonym is 'productive'.
fields.hint: A prolific writer publishes many books.
fields.whyA: 'Barren' means producing nothing, the opposite of prolific.
fields.whyC: A prolific writer produces a lot, but that says nothing about talent.
fields.whyD: Prolific people may become famous, but the word refers to output, not fame.
fields.explanationTl: Ang prolific ay maraming nagagawa o napo-produce, kaya ang synonym ay productive.
fields.hintTl: Ang prolific na writer ay maraming librong nailalabas.

reason: 'Typical' was a weak synonym and distractors near-duplicates; rewritten as context item

fields.text:
Adobo is the quintessential Filipino dish.

In this sentence, 'quintessential' most nearly means:
fields.explanation: 'Quintessential' means being the most perfect or representative example of something; adobo stands for Filipino cooking.
fields.hint: The sentence says adobo is the best example of what Filipino food is like.
fields.whyA: 'Rarest' is the opposite; a quintessential example is the standard one.
fields.whyC: Being a perfect example has nothing to do with price.
fields.whyD: Quintessential is about how well something represents a type, not its age.
fields.explanationTl: Ang quintessential ay ang pinaka-perfect o pinaka-representative na example. Ang adobo ang pinaka-representative ng Filipino food.
fields.hintTl: Sinasabi ng sentence na ang adobo ang best example ng pagkaing Pinoy.

reason: Distractors Weak/Timid/Fearful were near-duplicates; replaced two; stem given context

fields.text:
Despite many setbacks, she remained indomitable.

In this sentence, 'indomitable' most nearly means:
fields.hint: Someone indomitable cannot be defeated or subdued.
fields.whyC: 'Unpredictable' also starts with a 'not' prefix, but indomitable means not able to be tamed or beaten.
fields.whyD: 'Homebound' confuses 'domitable' with 'domestic' (home); the root means to tame.
fields.explanationTl: Ang indomitable ay hindi matalo o hindi mapasuko. Kahit maraming problema, lumaban pa rin siya, kaya unconquerable.
fields.hintTl: Ang taong indomitable ay hindi napapasuko o natatalo.
